coordinate_system: Absolute unmodified PNG pixels; origin top-left, +x right, +y down. cell and region are [x,y,width,height]; region bounds use alpha>16. Normalized anchors are relative to their complete cell.

prompt_set.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create BACK-FACING companion to attached FRONT action sprite atlas, preserving the exact SAME male resonance engineer, same anatomy scale, short ivory jacket with peacock teal panels, dark trousers/boots, dark wavy grey-streaked hair, copper circular receiver backpack, staggered ivory ceramic capacitors, hip crystal nodes, copper fork emitter, same overhead painted style. Input 1 is final front action atlas reference for character/scale/poses/layout; Input 2 is original character identity reference. Asset: SQUARE transparent game sprite atlas, TWO columns TWO rows, four equal square cells, no visible cell lines. The essential change is DIRECTION: all four characters now face NORTHEAST / SCREEN UPPER RIGHT, away from viewer, viewed from 50 degree high overhead THREE QUARTER BACK. Clearly see back of head, BACK of short jacket and BACKPACK chassis; face mostly hidden except slight right profile. Do not give another front-facing view. Receiver is now viewed from its convex copper back/side, ceramic capacitor backs and tubing visible. SAME compass facing NE in all frames; feet stand grounded, no tilt rotation tricks. Upper-left IDLE: right hand holds fork emitter low toward upper right, free hand near chest device, neutral separated feet. Upper-right WINDUP/GATHER: knees bent and shoulders curled forward, both elbows flex and hands drawn together toward front of chest; at this back angle hands partly occluded but side elbows clearly bent inward, equipment stays attached. Lower-left RELEASE: visible torso extends toward upper right, right arm thrusts emitter forward toward upper right, left arm ALSO extends with clearly OPEN PALM outward, broad unmistakable extended silhouette, both forearms visible beyond torso silhouette so release looks different from windup. Lower-right RECOVERY: torso returns upright, both elbows lower, emitter hand falls toward hip, free hand lowered and open. These are real joint/torso changes, NOT rotated copies. Layout is CRITICAL: each entire physical figure occupies ONLY CENTRAL 55-60 PERCENT of its own cell width and height, same SMALL figure scale as first input atlas, with VERY LARGE TRANSPARENT PADDING. About 20% empty transparent gutter on every cell side. Common boot baseline around 80 percent of EACH cell height. All emitter tips, fingers, boots, receivers, capacitors contained in their own quadrants; no overhang. Do NOT enlarge characters to fill cells. Preserve full opaque bodies, clean strong readable planes at final 80px display, material style and costume of exact reference. True transparent alpha background. No ground/shadow/environment, no grid/borders/labels/text/numbers/watermarks, no magic circles/beams/particles/glow/clouds/trails. No new mask, cloak, staff, armor or wizard costume. Only four physical NE back-facing action poses.

prompt_set.prompt: EDIT ONLY FRAMING of the attached BACK-facing 2x2 transparent character action atlas. KEEP exact northeast back-facing direction, four original authentic body poses, same painterly engineer identity/costume/backpack/receiver/emitter. The figures are too large for reliable sprite padding. SHRINK ALL FOUR CHARACTERS to TWO THIRDS (66%) OF THEIR CURRENT SIZE inside their OWN quadrants, then recenter each in its own quadrant. Keep the square canvas unchanged and keep each character the same anatomical scale as the others. They must look conspicuously SMALLER with large empty transparent space. Upper-left idle; upper-right gather with folded elbows/hands close to chest; lower-left release both arms stretched toward UPPER RIGHT, open free palm and emitter hand clearly separated; lower-right recovery with lowered hands. Whole body and equipment must fit in central 55-60% of each quadrant, large 20% transparent padding from every cell edge, common boot baseline at approximately 78% of each quadrant height. Do not refill the frame with large characters. Preserve whole visible feet, all fingers, all emitter tips; no cropping. True transparent background and opaque characters. No new objects, no front-facing poses, no additional views, ground, shadows, cells/grid/labels/text, energy effects, spells, glow, particles. Only resize and recenter four existing BACK-facing poses smaller in 2x2 layout.

identity_invariants: Adult male engineer with dark grey-streaked hair, moustache and chin beard
Short ivory jacket with peacock-teal panels; brown work trousers and boots
Copper/ceramic round receiver and carried ceramic capacitors
Short fork-shaped mineral emitter and hip crystal nodes
postprocessing: None. Selected final PNG copied byte-for-byte from built-in imagegen output. Alpha retained. Python used only to read pixels and write JSON; no image editing, resampling, cropping or compositing.
limitations: Four authored key poses only; no skeletal rig, in-between frames, locomotion cycle, hurt or death animation.
Source poses are independently rendered; small clothing/equipment and perspective inconsistencies remain. Back view hides some capacitors and interprets receiver rear housing.
Common per-bank scale and explicit foot anchors compensate layout placement; verify final 80px game display and timing in runtime.

Original built-in imagegen preview visually reviewed. The separate local view_image preview intermittently displayed opaque interiors as black; original pixel sampling verified near-opaque colored interiors. No pixel data was altered to work around preview behavior.

qa.visual_review: Four complete physical character poses, distinct inward gather / outward extended release / lowered recovery. No baked VFX, ground, text, dividers or shadows. Front southeast and back northeast are visibly different views.
